name: egress-guard-shapes
description: Outbound-request (SSRF) guard shapes: a hostile target corpus - the dotted v4 forms, the IPv6 wrappers that reach the same address (IPv4-mapped/compatible/NAT64, dotted and hex tails), the full internal v6 ranges, and scheme/userinfo/encoding tricks - fired at the app's OWN allow/deny guard route, with a public-control differential so a blanket-deny guard is not mistaken for a strong one. Zero dependencies, zero sockets: the guard answers in-process, the pack never dials.
